listing.name: Zombies Ate My Neighbors / Zombies Ate My Neighbors PC Port (moshferatu)
listing.summary: A Zombies Ate My Neighbors PC engine using your own original USA cartridge data.

steps.title: Choose your original USA ROM
steps.instruction: Use your own uncompressed 1,048,576-byte USA Zombies Ate My Neighbors ROM. Keep it outside the player folder. Select it in the launcher, then choose Play.

steps.title: Start the managed Windows player
steps.instruction: Open the installed zamn_launcher.exe and select your original ROM in the game settings. Keep zamn.exe and SDL2 beside the launcher.

steps.title: Run the upstream Linux launcher
steps.instruction: Extract zamn-linux-x86_64.tar.gz and run ./zamn_launcher from the extracted zamn folder. Keep the launcher, zamn and the bundled SDL2 library together. On Linux you can type the ROM path or drop the file onto the launcher.

warnings: The upstream Linux build is experimental and player-managed. Close both the launcher and the game before replacing the runtime or backing up its files. Keep the creating version with its configuration, quicksave and high scores.

references.title: Check the inspected Linux build
references.instruction: The 20261028 Linux launcher and bundled library need glibc 2.38 or later. The launcher needs an available system font in a supported location, such as DejaVu Sans. The expected USA ROM has SHA-256 b27e2e957fa760f4f483e2af30e03062034a6c0066984f2e284cc2cb430b2059.

references.title: Keep the default player data
references.instruction: Preserve zamn.ini, zamn.quicksave, zamn.hiscore and any matching .tmp files in your working copy. Preserve custom config, high-score and output locations separately.

presentation.manual_preparation: Use your own USA 1,048,576-byte Zombies Ate My Neighbors ROM. Upstream's compatibility SHA-256 is b27e2e957fa760f4f483e2af30e03062034a6c0066984f2e284cc2cb430b2059; Core does not acquire, authenticate or import it. Keep the original outside the engine directory. The normal Windows entry is zamn_launcher.exe: select your ROM and settings there, then use its Play button. Keep zamn.exe, SDL2 and the whole package together. The normal launcher tracks and reaps its child and returns to its settings UI after the game exits; close both before maintenance. This source review is not an installed full-session or forced-exit certification. Core preserves default local zamn.ini, zamn.quicksave, zamn.hiscore and their atomic .tmp companions. Explicit config, high-score, capture, movie and other user-selected paths can be external and remain outside Core backup/removal. Preserve every effective creating path and complete old runtime before updating or restoring; the quicksave ROM/structure checks do not promise compatibility across future builds. Upstream mixes native game logic with hardware emulation; no complete-native, gameplay or real-save acceptance is implied. Core owns engine replacement, upstream owns ROM selection and settings.
